# Build local saved-message headers from content when the create response only has an ID

1108 expects exactly one returned item, creates a local header associated with its EWS ID, parses the original MIME content and populates/commits that header because the CreateItem response lacks those fields. The current implementation has moved local creation into C++: it parses the original header block, applies it to a detached header, associates the exchange ID, then attaches/commits it. Keep the identity from the response and the metadata from content separate. The newer operation framework is current context, not a fully studied later migration.

Scope: EWS response identity and local header source.
